decisions.reason: A 2K resin injection unit fits the firm's core pumping and plural-component competence, and after only one year with no sign of shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
This second injection unit gives the firm a fuller range, and the slack of an established medium-sized machinery firm lets it carry the product while results are still uncertain.
Automatic airless guns are a staple of the core spray business, sell alongside pumps and spare parts, and are unlikely to fall below aspiration levels.
Manual airless guns are a high-volume core accessory with steady demand, so dropping one would make little sense.
Air-assisted airless guns complete the gun portfolio for finishing customers and draw on existing manufacturing routines at low marginal cost.

A data logger is further from the firm's mechanical core and its results are more uncertain, but it supports the digital and quality-documentation trend, so slack and the innovation goal justify keeping it for now.
